verdict.rationale: AFK is an ops-automation workspace connected to apps like Mercury, Gusto, Carta and Stripe, so event-based triggering is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows processes started by the user or from a goal, plus internal dependency resumption between steps. Nothing documents workflows starting from external events such as a new record, message, email or form submission.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)
